description: Restructure repository into /backend, /frontend, /docs layout. Move all backend source (src/, package.json, tsconfig.json, SDK, templates, minimal-rootfs, all test files, config files) into /backend. Create /frontend and /docs directories. Remove unnecessary files from root (keep only top-level README.md, LICENSE, .gitignore). Update backend/package.json paths, backend/tsconfig.json paths, and backend/.github workflows.
steps: Create /backend, /frontend, /docs directory structure at repository root
Move .github/ → backend/.github/ and update workflow paths to reference backend/ locations
Copy LICENSE to backend/LICENSE (keep original at root)
Update backend/package.json: change all script paths that reference TypeScript to use correct paths (dist/ output already relative, no change needed), add workspace root reference if needed
Update backend/tsconfig.json if any absolute paths exist (check outDir, rootDir)
Update backend/.github/workflows/*.yml to use correct working directories (add 'working-directory: backend' or update paths)
Create backend/.gitignore that includes dist/, node_modules/, etc. (copy from root .gitignore)
Update root .gitignore to exclude backend/dist/, backend/node_modules/, frontend/node_modules/ if any
Remove quick-start.bat from root (dev script not needed in restructured layout)
acceptance_criteria: All TypeScript source code, tests, and build configuration moved to /backend
Root directory contains only README.md, LICENSE, .gitignore, and the three subdirectories (/backend, /frontend, /docs)
backend/package.json scripts still work (npm run build, npm test, npm start from backend/ directory)
No broken path references in backend/tsconfig.json or backend/package.json
verification: cd backend && npm run build — TypeScript compiles successfully to backend/dist/
cd backend && npm test — all existing tests pass
Verify backend/.github/workflows/*.yml files reference backend paths correctly (manual inspection or dry-run if possible)
ls at root shows only: README.md, LICENSE, .gitignore, backend/, frontend/, docs/
